articles.제목: Agreement aims to support US maritime nuclear
articles.원문 요약: The American Bureau of Shipping and the US Department of Energy have signed a memorandum of understanding to advance modern commercial nuclear technology at sea.

articles.제목: IAEA carries out fresh LTO review mission to Oskarshamn
articles.원문 요약: The International Atomic Energy Agency team focused on aspects related to the safe Long Term Operation of Sweden's Oskarshamn 3 nuclear power unit during the visit, which followed a similar mission two years earlier.

Westinghouse places initial orders for Polish plant
articles.원문 요약: Westinghouse has placed conditional purchase orders for safety-related modules with four Polish companies, a week after being commissioned to begin ordering long-lead items for the first unit of Poland's planned first nuclear power plant.

articles.제목: Namibia takes step towards nuclear power
articles.원문 요약: Namibia's Prime Minister has appointed a Nuclear Commissioner to coordinate preparations for nuclear energy and put in place a structure to provide high-level policy coordination and strategic oversight.

articles.제목: Kairos Power automates fuel pebble inspections
articles.원문 요약: A new facility at Kairos Power's Manufacturing Development Campus in Albuquerque, New Mexico, verifies manufacturing specifications and engraves each fuel pebble with a unique code so it can be traced through testing and operation.
